forcePayRateToMatchAccrualRate.description:
If this value is set to true, then the cash value of leave taken
(i.e. what is paid to the employee when they take leave)
will be calculated based on the rate(s) that the employee was paid
for the accrual(s) that the leave is being taken from.

Definitiv.Api.Dtos.Payroll.EmployeeAccru.description:
Types of cash out requests handled:
1. Specific amount             (Units != null and Rate != null)
2. Value based on accrued rate (Units != null and Rate == null)
3. Entire available balance    (Units == null and Rate == null)

Definitiv.Api.Dtos.Payroll.Superannuatio.description:
Represents two distinct database model concepts: {SuperannuationServiceNotification} and {SuperannuationBatchPaymentMessage}.
The reason separate DTOs are not used for each is because both pieces of information are expected to be presented within the same grid of results (i.e. "Notifications" tab), which inevitably makes them share common data columns.
